title: Is the Room-Temperature Superconductor Here?
synopsis: The discovery of a room-temperature superconductor could revolutionize many industries.

fullText.simplified:
常温超导体来了吗？

    中国有个成语叫“铁石心肠”，意思是心肠像铁和石头一样坚硬，不会轻易为感情所动。古代人相信铁和石头是最坚硬的材料。后来，金刚石出现了，它替代铁和石头成为了新的最坚硬的材料。人们把它镶在戒指上，说着“爱情恒久远，钻石永流传”。到了当代，随着科学技术日新月异的发展，人们对材料的要求已经远不止坚硬这一个标准了，隔热、绝缘、柔韧等等都是在选择某种材料时不可或缺的重要条件之一。近日，材料界一篇论文的发表在全世界掀起了热烈的讨论。
    韩国一科学团队发表论文称发现了全球首个常温超导材料——改性铅磷灰石晶体结构，编号LK-99。一石激起千层浪，全球各大实验室都开足马力，尝试合成这一新材料，超导概念股也因此一路高歌猛进。各界反应如此强烈，原因就在于超导材料是关乎能源革命的关键材料，一旦实现常温超导，人类发展将进入新纪元。
    超导材料与传统材料相比，有显著的两大特点：零电阻、抗磁性。零电阻的特性使电力在传输过程中没有损耗，如果将其制作成手机零件，手机发热的问题将迎刃而解；如果将其制作成电力传输装置，全球电力损耗能将减少15%以上。抗磁性的特性则已被投入应用，磁悬浮列车就是应用了超导体材料。列车漂浮在轨道上方，运行时不与地面接触，没有摩擦力，只受到来自空气的阻力，因此速度非常快。目前世界上最快的测试速度来自日本JR公司的L0型磁悬浮列车，已经达到了603千米每小时，也就是说不到两个小时就能从柏林赶到巴黎。
    超导材料的种种优势使其一出现就备受关注，但目前发现的只有低温超导材料和高温超导材料。虽然技术方面较为成熟，但这些材料都需要在特定的温度下才能实现超导状态，这给超导技术的实际应用带来了巨大的困难。如果能在常温下实现超导，那就意味着人们能冲破难关，将超导技术的应用广泛地推展开来。不但能够实现更高效的电力输送，把磁悬浮列车成本大幅度降下来，而且受控核聚变、量子计算机等技术也将实现突破，人类将迎来一个新的时代。
    目前各大实验室已经能合成LK-99，理論計算显示其有常温超导的可能性，但其性能测试结果仍然存疑，有待进一步确认。发现LK-99的团队也要求将论文下架，因为他们认为理论仍然不够严谨。无论最终结果如何，新材料的研发还会继续。因为人类的好奇心永不停歇，对美好未来的期待也永不停歇。
fullText.traditional:
常溫超導體來了嗎？

    中國有個成語叫“鐵石心腸”，意思是心腸像鐵和石頭一樣堅硬，不會輕易為感情所動。古代人相信鐵和石頭是最堅硬的材料。後來，金剛石出現了，它替代鐵和石頭成為了新的最堅硬的材料。人們把它鑲在戒指上，說著“愛情恆久遠，鑽石永流傳”。到了當代，隨著科學技術日新月異的發展，人們對材料的要求已經遠不止堅硬這一個標準了，隔熱、絕緣、柔韌等等都是在選擇某種材料時不可或缺的重要條件之一。近日，材料界一篇論文的發表在全世界掀起了熱烈的討論。
    韓國一科學團隊發表論文稱發現了全球首個常溫超導材料——改性鉛磷灰石晶體結構，編號LK-99。一石激起千層浪，全球各大實驗室都開足馬力，嘗試合成這一新材料，超導概念股也因此一路高歌猛進。各界反應如此強烈，原因就在於超導材料是關乎能源革命的關鍵材料，一旦實現常溫超導，人類發展將進入新紀元。
    超導材料與傳統材料相比，有顯著的兩大特點：零電阻、抗磁性。零電阻的特性使電力在傳輸過程中沒有損耗，如果將其製作成手機零件，手機發熱的問題將迎刃而解；如果將其製作成電力傳輸裝置，全球電力損耗能將減少15%以上。抗磁性的特性則已被投入應用，磁懸浮列車就是應用了超導體材料。列車漂浮在軌道上方，運行時不與地面接觸，沒有摩擦力，只受到來自空氣的阻力，因此速度非常快。目前世界上最快的測試速度來自日本JR公司的L0型磁懸浮列車，已經達到了603千米每小時，也就是說不到兩個小時就能從柏林趕到巴黎。
    超導材料的種種優勢使其一出現就備受關注，但目前發現的只有低溫超導材料和高溫超導材料。雖然技術方面較為成熟，但這些材料都需要在特定的溫度下才能實現超導狀態，這給超導技術的實際應用帶來了巨大的困難。如果能在常溫下實現超導，那就意味著人們能衝破難關，將超導技術的應用廣泛地推展開來。不但能夠實現更高效的電力輸送，把磁懸浮列車成本大幅度降下來，而且受控核聚變、量子計算機等技術也將實現突破，人類將迎來一個新的時代。
    目前各大實驗室已經能合成LK-99，理論計算顯示其有常溫超導的可能性，但其性能測試結果仍然存疑，有待進一步確認。發現LK-99的團隊也要求將論文下架，因為他們認為理論仍然不夠嚴謹。無論最終結果如何，新材料的研發還會繼續。因為人類的好奇心永不停歇，對美好未來的期待也永不停歇。

sentences.traditional: 那就意味著人們能衝破難關，將超導技術的應用廣泛地推展開來。
sentences.pinyin: nà jiù yì wèi zhe rén men néng chōng pò nán guān jiāng chāo dǎo jì shù de yìng yòng guǎng fàn de tuī zhǎn kāi lái
sentences.english: If superconductivity could be achieved at room temperature, ..

sentences.simplified: 不但能够实现更高效的电力输送，把磁悬浮列车成本大幅度降下来，
sentences.traditional: 不但能夠實現更高效的電力輸送，把磁懸浮列車成本大幅度降下來，
sentences.pinyin: bú dàn néng gòu shí xiàn gèng gāo xiào de diàn lì shū sòng bǎ cí xuán fú liè chē chéng běn dà fú dù jiàng xià lái
sentences.english: .. it would mean that people could overcome the difficulties and greatly expand the application of superconducting technology.

sentences.simplified: 而且受控核聚变、量子计算机等技术也将实现突破，人类将迎来一个新的时代。
sentences.traditional: 而且受控核聚變、量子計算機等技術也將實現突破，人類將迎來一個新的時代。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě shòu kòng hé jù biàn liàng zǐ jì suàn jī děng jì shù yě jiāng shí xiàn tū pò rén lèi jiāng yíng lái yí ge xīn de shí dài
sentences.english: Not only can it achieve more efficient power transmission and significantly reduce the cost of maglev trains, ..
.. controlled nuclear fusion, quantum computers, and other technologies will also achieve breakthroughs, ushering in a new era for mankind.

sentences.simplified: 目前各大实验室已经能合成LK-99，
sentences.traditional: 目前各大實驗室已經能合成LK-99，
sentences.pinyin: mù qián gè dà shí yàn shì yǐ jīng néng hé chéng 2 2

sentences.simplified: 理論計算显示其有常温超导的可能性，
sentences.traditional: 理論計算顯示其有常溫超導的可能性，
sentences.pinyin: lǐ lùn jì suàn xiǎn shì qí yǒu cháng wēn chāo dǎo de kě néng xìng
sentences.english: At present, major laboratories have been able to synthesize LK-99.

sentences.simplified: 但其性能测试结果仍然存疑，有待进一步确认。
sentences.traditional: 但其性能測試結果仍然存疑，有待進一步確認。
sentences.pinyin: dàn qí xìng néng cè shì jié guǒ réng rán cún yí yǒu dài jìn yí bù què rèn
sentences.english: Theoretical calculations show that it has the potential for superconductivity at room temperature.

sentences.simplified: 发现LK-99的团队也要求将论文下架，因为他们认为理论仍然不够严谨。
sentences.traditional: 發現LK-99的團隊也要求將論文下架，因為他們認為理論仍然不夠嚴謹。

sentences.english: However, its performance test results still have unresolved issues and require further verification.

sentences.simplified: 无论最终结果如何，新材料的研发还会继续。
sentences.traditional: 無論最終結果如何，新材料的研發還會繼續。
sentences.pinyin: wú lùn zuì zhōng jié guǒ rú hé xīn cái liào de yán fā hái huì jì xù
sentences.english: The team that discovered LK-99 also requested the retraction of the paper, as they believe the theory is still not rigorous enough.

sentence_translations: Is the Room-Temperature Superconductor Here?
There is a Chinese idiom, “to have a heart of iron and stone”.
It means that the heart is as hard as iron and stone and is not easily moved by emotions.
Ancient people believed that iron and stone were the hardest materials.
Later, diamonds appeared, replacing iron and stone as the new hardest material.
People embed diamonds into rings, saying “Love is everlasting, diamonds are forever.”
In the present age, with the rapid development of science and technology, ..
.. people’s requirements for materials have gone far beyond just hardness.
Thermal insulation, electrical insulation, flexibility, and so on are all necessary, important criteria when choosing a certain material.
Recently, the publication of a paper in the field of materials science has sparked heated discussion worldwide.
A South Korean scientific team published a paper claiming to have discovered the world’s first room-temperature superconducting material—
a modified lead apatite crystal structure codenamed LK-99.
One stone can create a thousand waves.
Laboratories around the world went full steam ahead, trying to synthesize this new material.
Semiconductor shares surged dramatically as a result.
The reason for such a strong reaction across all sectors is that superconducting materials are key to the energy revolution.
Once room-temperature superconductivity is achieved, human development will enter a new era.
Compared to traditional materials, superconducting materials have two significant characteristics: zero resistance and diamagnetism.
The characteristic of zero resistance allows electricity to be transmitted without loss.
If they are made into mobile phone parts, the problem of phone overheating will be readily solved.
If they are made into electrical power transmission devices, global electricity consumption could be reduced by more than 15%.
The property of diamagnetism has already been put into use.
The maglev train is such an application of superconducting materials.
The train floats above the tracks and does not touch the ground when it operates, so there is no friction.
The train is only subject to air resistance, and therefore it is very fast.
The fastest test speed in the world currently comes from the Japanese JR Group’s L0 maglev train, which reached 603 kilometers per hour.
This means that it can get from Berlin to Paris in less than two hours.
The various advantages of superconducting materials have attracted much attention since their emergence.
But so far, only low-temperature superconducting materials and high-temperature superconducting materials have been discovered.
Although the technology is relatively mature, these materials can only achieve superconductivity at specific temperatures.
This brings great difficulties for the practical application of superconducting technology.
If superconductivity could be achieved at room temperature, ..
.. it would mean that people could overcome the difficulties and greatly expand the application of superconducting technology.
Not only can it achieve more efficient power transmission and significantly reduce the cost of maglev trains, ..
.. controlled nuclear fusion, quantum computers, and other technologies will also achieve breakthroughs, ushering in a new era for mankind.
At present, major laboratories have been able to synthesize LK-99.
Theoretical calculations show that it has the potential for superconductivity at room temperature.
However, its performance test results still have unresolved issues and require further verification.
The team that discovered LK-99 also requested the retraction of the paper, as they believe the theory is still not rigorous enough.
Regardless of the final outcome, the development of new materials will continue.
Because human curiosity never ceases, the hope for a bright future also never ceases.
